references.text: The altar of burnt offering also had horns on its corners, showing a parallel in the design of the sanctuary's altars.
Describes the actual construction of the incense altar with the same dimensions: one cubit long, one cubit wide, and two cubits high.
The horns on the altar of burnt offering were made as one piece with the altar, just like the horns of the incense altar.
Ezekiel's vision of the temple includes an altar of wood with a corresponding square shape and horns.
Revelation mentions the golden altar before the throne, which is connected to the incense altar in the tabernacle.
Refers to the four horns on the golden altar that is before God, a direct reference to the design of the incense altar.
